EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Hello, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
Enjoying the solstice? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Night during
the day IS an acquired taste.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Merhaba, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
Gündönümünün tadını çıkarıyor musun?
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Gündüz vakti gece yaşamak biraz
alışkanlık istiyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}All this sunlessness... It's just so
disorienting, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tanta oscuridad... me desorienta,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Cuando ha sonado el despertador,
pensaba que se había estropeado.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sans le soleil pour nous éclairer...
Oh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, je perds tous mes
repères, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tutto questo buio mi disorienta.
Sei tu l'unico mio faro nell'oscurità,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Verlierst du in dieser Dunkelheit
auch so leicht die Orientierung wie
ich, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das ist schlimm!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bu güneşsizlik... İnsanın bütün yön
duygusunu bozuyor, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Is that you, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oh, good.
I can barely see anything in all
this dark solstice gloom.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Eres {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Menos mal.
A duras penas puedo ver por
dónde piso...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Sei tu, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ah, meno male. Non ci vedo niente.
La mia vista non è più quella
di una volta e il buio non aiuta.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Sen misin, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oh, iyi.
Bu gündönümü karanlığında göz gözü görmüyor.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Qué tal, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
Hoy no es un buen día para
cotillear, angelito...
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Los vecinos estamos tan
desanimados que no ocurre
nada interesante.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ça va, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ? Ce solstice va
encore durer un moment,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} j'espère
que tu aimes être dans le noir.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Na? Kannst du die Dunkelheit noch
eine Weile ertragen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittwinter {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}dauert noch ein paar
Stündchen, fürchte ich!

EN:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Well,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hello again{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Where ARE you getting all your
energy from? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}I'm fizzling out.
I'm really looking forward to the sun
coming back tomorrow, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Hola, cariñín{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
¿De dónde sacas tanta energía?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Yo ya no puedo más.
Estoy deseando que se acabe el día
y que vuelva el sol, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Re-bonjour{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
D'où tires-tu toute cette énergie,
dis-moi ?
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je t'envie, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, tu sais.
Vivement demain que le soleil
revienne enfin, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Ma ciao{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!
Che aria frizzantina, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Anche tu
sembri assai frizzante, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Pekâlâ,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yine merhaba{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bu enerjiyi NEREDEN buluyorsun? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Benim
pilim bitiyor.
Yarın güneşin dönmesini dört gözle
bekliyorum, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}La temperatura bajará en picado
cuando sea de noche. O sea, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}ya es
de noche, pero{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} más tarde...
{{TAG:0003:0008:}}¡Aaaah, qué lío!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Disculpa, solete,
el solsticio siempre me hace
perder los nervios, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Good evening, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
It's seriously getting chilly tonight,
isn't it! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0014:}}So cold...
ES:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Buenas noches, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
Esto se está poniendo feo,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0014:}} cada
vez hace más frío...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}İyi akşamlar, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
Bu gece hava gerçekten keskinleşiyor,
değil mi! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Çok soğuk...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}We really should get inside, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}or else
they'll dig us out of a snowbank
NEXT {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Winter Solstice{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Será mejor que volvamos a casa,
o nos encontrarán convertid{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}s en
estatuas de hielo, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
Sería una manera elegante de pasar
a la posteridad, {{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡pero todavía
somos muy jóvenes!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr... {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, il faudrait
vraiment rentrer maintenant, ou on
nous retrouvera seulement au dégel.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Hai presente quelle gare di sculture
di ghiaccio, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? Potrei
partecipare anch'io... come scultura!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Wir sollten uns wirklich drinnen im
Warmen verkriechen, bevor wir zu
Eisklumpen erstarren, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Gerçekten içeri girsek iyi olur, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}yoksa
bizi bir kar yığınının içinden ANCAK
bir sonraki {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kış Gündönümü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
çıkarırlar,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Stay warm, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}The solstice
is only going to make tonight even
colder, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Abrígate, pastelito. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Si necesitas
una buena manta, yo puedo
dejarte alguna, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Reste au chaud, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}À cause
du solstice, il va faire vraiment très
froid cette nuit, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Sıcak kal, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Gündönümü
bu geceyi daha da soğuk
yapacak, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
